podcast.title: Lawsuit against Eddie Vedder (2010)
podcast.body: Gordon Peterson sued Eddie Vedder for covering "Hard Sun," claiming Vedder did not get permission and "eroded the integrity of the song" by altering some lyrics. Despite the lawsuit, a judge ruled in April 2010 that Vedder had not materially infringed on the song. "But Peterson then sued Eddie for a not getting permission to cover the song and be quote eroding the integrity of the song by changing some of the lyrics."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Departure from Music Industry
podcast.body: Gordon Peterson, who went by the name Indio, chose to walk away from the music industry after the success of *Big Harvest* and "Hard Sun" in 1989. He reportedly disliked how the industry operated, how it treated people, and how it made him feel personally. "He didn't like how it worked, how it treated people, how it made him feel. So he quit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
